environment.materials: Two receivables from the sales-invoice flow, one active fund account and one receipt registered through the page

replication.notes: RISEMAP receivable and payable views are empty; title, navigation, view modes, filters, columns and empty states are observed, while row behavior and same-material outcomes remain unavailable.

visual.notes: Populated desktop and 390x844 narrow views, payable empty state, advanced filters and receipt dialog were checked in the built-in browser. Independent visual review remains pending.

interaction.notes: Forge direction and grouping switches, semantic search, reset, required-field blocking, over-amount blocking and receipt registration passed. RISEMAP row-level behavior remains unavailable.

business.notes: Forge receivable, unallocated receipt, fund-account balance and order linkage passed before and after same-SQLite restart. Allocation/writeoff and RISEMAP same-material outcomes remain pending.

requirements.steps: Open both current pages and inspect the title, description, five entries and direction switch.
requirements.expected: Matching responsibility and reachable finance entries.
requirements.observed: Title, responsibility, five entries and both directions match the observed page structure; target pages remain individually reviewed later.

requirements.steps: Switch directions and order view, search by related customer, expand advanced filters and reset.
requirements.expected: Controls have clear scope, related names are searchable and reset restores defaults.
requirements.observed: Direction, real-order grouping, related-name search, advanced-filter toggle and reset passed.

requirements.steps: Inspect both directions with populated business records.
requirements.expected: Business source, order/project, responsible/contact and amounts resolve from real links.
requirements.observed: Populated receivables passed; current payables are empty and require material for full verification.

requirements.steps: Switch every available grouped view and compare record counts and totals.
requirements.expected: Grouping keys and totals use actual party, order and project links.
requirements.observed: Receivable order grouping passed with two actual orders; other grouped views lack matching populated material.

requirements.steps: Submit an empty receipt, an over-amount receipt and a valid receipt.
requirements.expected: Invalid actions are blocked and a valid action creates an unallocated receipt without prematurely settling the receivable.
requirements.observed: Forge paths passed; RISEMAP row behavior remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Check desktop and 390x844 views with data, payable empty state, advanced filters and receipt dialog.
requirements.expected: Usable first screen without page-level overflow; wide table scrolls inside its card.
requirements.observed: Desktop and narrow checks passed, including stacked dates and full dialog controls.

requirements.steps: Read receivable, receipt, fund account and order links, restart the same SQLite and read again.
requirements.expected: Source, amount, status and linkages remain consistent through allocation and writeoff.
requirements.observed: Pre-allocation Forge state passed before and after restart; allocation/writeoff and RISEMAP same-material result remain pending.
